@echo off
setlocal
set "PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8"
set "PYTHONPATH=%~dp0src"
if not defined FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME if exist "%~dp0..\ideas\" set "FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME=%~dp0..\ideas"
if not defined FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME set "FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME=D:\FoxEra\ideas"
set "PY=python"
where py >nul 2>nul && set "PY=py -3.11"
rem SAN PHAM DOI THU -> Y MOI. Keo tha file .txt vao nut nay, hoac de mac dinh
rem D:\FoxEra\ideas\intake\rivals.txt. Moi dong: [@brand] Doi thu ^| Ten SP ^| url ^| ghi chu
set "F=%~1"
if "%F%"=="" set "F=%FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME%\intake\rivals.txt"
if not exist "%F%" echo Khong thay file: %F% & pause & exit /b 2
set "EXTRA="
chcp 65001 >nul
if defined TRELLO_KEY if defined TRELLO_TOKEN set "EXTRA=--trello"
%PY% -m foxera_core.ideas.run x --rival "%F%" %EXTRA%
echo.
pause
exit /b %errorlevel%
